steps.code:
# Fetch all unique songs and count artist occurrences
from collections import Counter

artist_counts = Counter()
for song_id in unique_song_ids:
    song = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=access_token, song_id=song_id)
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_counts[artist['name']] += 1

# Get top 3 artists
top_artists = [name for name, _ in artist_counts.most_common(3)]
print(top_artists)
